properties.headline: Storm Warning issued November 14 at 2:47PM PST until November 15 at 3:00AM PST by NWS Eureka CA
properties.description:
* WHAT...For the Storm Warning, south winds 30 to 40 kt with
gusts up to 50 kt and seas 17 to 20 feet. For the Hazardous
Seas Warning, very steep and hazardous seas 18 to 23 feet and
southwest winds 5 to 15 kt with gusts up to 25 kt expected.

* WHERE...Waters from Pt. St. George to Cape Mendocino CA from
10 to 60 nm.

* WHEN...For the Storm Warning, until 3 AM PST Sunday. For the
Hazardous Seas Warning, from 3 AM Sunday to 3 PM PST Monday.

* IMPACTS...Very strong winds will cause hazardous seas which
could capsize or damage vessels and reduce visibility.
properties.instruction:
Mariners should remain in port, alter course, and/or secure the
vessel for severe conditions.

NWSheadline: STORM WARNING REMAINS IN EFFECT UNTIL 3 AM PST SUNDAY... ...HAZARDOUS SEAS WARNING IN EFFECT FROM 3 AM SUNDAY TO 3 PM PST MONDAY
